text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel achieved her goal of placing 
in the top 3 of a Graded race. Around that 
time, her classmates were undergoing 
grueling training for the upcoming 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is also giving it her all for 
the grand stage. Seeing this, Sakura 
Laurel can't help but sprint forward at 
full power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—As a result, she suffered a mild muscle 
strain. She acted cheerful as always, 
saying it was a good opportunity to figure 
out her limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to let go of her feelings for the 
Japanese Derby, Sakura Laurel proposes 
something to her Trainer: that they never 
speak of the Classic races again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All for the ultimate goal of the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe. For now, just like 
before... she set her sights on placing 
within the top 3 in a GIII or higher race.
